speaker: john_heminges
text: Mine ends satis. I have looked twice. The word is the Latin, and the Latin is what I was given.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Mine ends on a word I can almost hear, and then it thinks better of it and goes back into the tag. Two copies. One cue. I would like to be told which man I am.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have learned them wrong. Both of you. A cue is a cue. If the copies differ, the difference is in the learning, not in my hand.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Bring them to the chest. I will not have two Dulls, and I will not have the pedant cueing a ghost.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, my copy. Item, his. Set them where the light is honest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Satis on yours, John. And on his, a strike, and under the strike my own words, mending the end. That is not his learning. That is my correction, sitting on the wrong copy.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: Then I missed three entrances on a book that was trying to help me, and I could not hear the help. I am not proud of the number. I am less ashamed than I was a minute ago.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: I will not recopy a line until it is settled which book is the book. I can write either length. I will not write both and call them one.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Which book is the book is the only question I have. Answer it, or take both home and stop pretending the prompt can choose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will take both. The end of the line changes tonight. One end. Plain English. A word a man could hear through oak. Then you will have a book, Humphrey, and not a pair.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: While thou art confessing a copy, hear a size. I have him. The boards took the speech, and the speech did not shrink. Noon may audit what is left. I am not waiting on noon to know it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then thou hast the size. I heard thee fill the yard without adding a word. That is the mend I could not do from a chamber.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good. Item, the size is found. Item, the cue is not. Do not let the one stand in for the other when you tell the story at dinner.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: I will come in when the word is a word. Until then I am a man behind oak, and oak has won three times.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Three times is your count. My count is two books. I go home with neither in my satchel. The plot at least agrees with itself.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot agrees because I wrote it once. Your parts have been living a double life. I want that life ended before I paste anything.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing is pasted today. The slip waits on the rewrite. Burbage has the size. The rest of you have a disagreement, and the disagreement is mine.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Own it, then, and let us out. The morning has done the work noon was going to claim.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, you own it. Item, the chest stays as it is. Two parts, one struck, and no paste until the end of the line is a single end.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I will not paste a quarrel. Bring me one sentence in the morning, and I will hate it on the proper grounds.

speaker: richard_cowley
text: One sentence I can hear. I will take it dull. Dull is the employment.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: The count of the lines can wait on the sentence. I have said I will not write both. I am leaving with empty hands.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Empty hands are right. The night will choose the end. You will have it in one hand, Richard, not in two books.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: And I will have the same size when we come again, unless thou shrinkest the yard overnight. Do not. I have spent the morning on its length.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Go home, Will. The yard has had its morning, and the morning is the whole rehearsal we have.
